title: The path from playtest to production
summary: The current download remains the earlier tested playtest. The recovered survival candidate is private, uncommitted and not release-ready. Every requested feature stays on this trail until its acceptance gate passes.

candidate.passed: Core8: all four managed assemblies, three-biome bake, 1,450 native cases and Windows build passed. Its exact package passed Solo, Coop2, Coop6, CampSave and ZombieCoop.
candidate.limits: These passes do not certify the whole package: Horde failed, Normal EngineFinale / GroupFire / Flight remain unaccepted, and human, controller, listening, Internet multiplayer, Steam and Deck gates remain open.
candidate.camp: The two-process Zombie check verified real 30-second shared camp safety, invasion after expiry and repeated entry without reset. Its 299-to-300-second wave transition was accelerated; Zombie save readback did not restart the process.

performance.state: Failed: p95 and strict melee-kill gate

candidate.measurement: One fixed-seed, manually staged ordinary-AI solo diagnostic: 30-second phases, 1280Ã—800 D3D11, 120 FPS cap, vSync off, i7-14700K / RTX 5070. Exceptional threats were isolated. GPU timing was unavailable. Active counts are separate from camera-frustum bounds; occlusion visibility was not measured. Production ordinary-AI cap remains 512, fallback 128. Natural thousands capacity and six-peer density are unverified.
candidate.route: A seeded Core7 HOME-return route rejected after real contact. Core8 passed another seed; the original failure is still open.
candidate.optimization: The small Core7/Core8 predicate comparison showed mixed, inconclusive changes. No meaningful general performance improvement is claimed.

phases.title: Finish the endless survival loop
criteria: Endless Zombie has no win, nuke or finale. Three total lives per stable participant; the third death ends that participantâ€™s run, and co-op ends when all registered participants are out. Final kills, survival time and waves stay visible.

Five-minute waves increase speed, damage and spawn pressure. Once per wave, shared camp safety lasts exactly 30 seconds with a prominent countdown; reentry, grenade refill and save/reload cannot reset it. Zombies invade after expiry.

Two weapon types per wave, both barred in the next wave then eligible again. Owned table retrieval costs about $100, retains upgrades and cannot double charge. Two grenades sit outside weapon slots and refill only at camp.
Earn compatible perks and combinations from kills, loot and harvests, with no paid loot boxes. Giant skeletons arrive every three minutes; 25 ordinary rockets remove about one quarter of 30,000 HP.
phases.gate: Native rules and selected package flows passed. Natural 10+ minute play, third-death results, Zombie process restart, two-peer arsenal/grenade transitions and boss cadence under load remain open. Later speed/damage/pressure tiers are bounded; a three-live-boss cap defers backlog.

phases.title: Prove crowded pursuit and performance
criteria: Fast contact attacks within about half a second, readable lunges and fair knockback; crowds keep pursuing and attacking. Animals jump or reposition to reach juniper perches.
Admit hordes throughout the map from multiple directions, scaling toward thousands through pooling, LOD and spatial/navigation work. Report real active AI separately from proxies.
Keep cheap visible frozen/batched corpse piles bounded, with no unbounded physics, revival or duplicate rewards.
phases.gate: 512 staged phase passed; 1024 failed; 2048 is unmeasured. Attribute animal/native/render/allocation costs before another optimization. Resolve the seeded return-route rejection, dense melee target churn, sustained corpse persistence and delayed/reordered leap transport. Natural growth, combined exceptional threats and six-peer density remain unaccepted.

phases.title: Raise the original visual quality
criteria: Improve original hunter, animal, monster and UFO models, textures, rigs and lighting while preserving silhouettes, hurtboxes and combat readability.
Keep mitten/block hands in first and third person, improve held flamethrower presentation, and keep a sky beam on lost gear until recovered or empty.

Retain bounded weapon/environment particles and existing pooled left/right boot-sole snow footprints; validate slope contact, fade and co-op consistency. Add a shared adaptive effects budget when measured.
phases.gate: Modest mitten/flamethrower/beacon and pooled footprint implementations already exist. Profile2 produced original-character palette/mittens and staged equipment/trail renders; representative images were inspected. Integrated near/far gameplay, dense-session cost, shared effects budget and human art acceptance remain open. High-end original character quality is still expected; no purchased or copied game/film assets.

phases.title: Make menus and profiles clear
criteria: Native Unity Normal / Zombie, Start New / Load / Resume, pause, settings and results flows remain readable at supported resolutions, with keyboard/controller focus, back and cancel.
Editable nonunique nickname and color preview persist across reopen/rejoin separately from private stable identity. Public results require explicit sharing consent.
phases.gate: Editable nickname/six-color preview, Apply/Cancel, separate device-profile persistence and matching-build protocol57 cosmetics are implemented in uncommitted profile2, with focused native passes. Separate-process color replication, late join/rejoin, actual menu pixels and controller/Deck hardware acceptance remain open. The earlier downloadable playtest still uses its original defaults.

phases.title: Earn perks and playable monster classes
criteria: Expand earned perk inventory and combinations, preserving weapon rotation, ownership, grenades and live weapon state.
Normal map victories unlock persisted playable classes. Bigfoot is a strong melee tank; Devil trades health for strong melee and bounded magic. Neither uses hunter guns.
Resolve the proposed third classâ€™s recorded creature identity before committing it; the current proposal is an Ash Crown undead-elk silhouette at fair player scale.
phases.gate: Current enemies are not playable classes. Class authority, unlock rollback/rejoin, progression, camera, collider, animation and balance still require implementation and validation.

phases.title: Put global records in every map
criteria: Physical boards partition records by map, mode, rules/version, class and team. Rank Normal completions separately from Zombie waves, time and kills.
Keep immutable run/private identity separate from mutable nicknames, with consent, idempotent retries and bounded cached/offline/loading/error states.
phases.gate: Only an opt-in local queue bounded to 16 exists. Contract and fake-adapter/UI work can proceed; no connected global service or internet-wide leaderboard is implemented. Service access is a later dependency.

phases.title: Verify the exact final private build
criteria: Run bound managed/native, build/package and persistence tests for the final source; cover repeated camp entry, waves, high-density combat and Normal regression.
Resolve actual-screen/HUD capture for Normal EngineFinale, GroupFire and Flight. Complete human gameplay/listening, physical controller/Deck and separate-PC Internet six-player checks.
phases.gate: Core8 remains the preserved private diagnostic package. Profile2 has focused native evidence only and has not been built or packaged. Commit only the fully verified recovered candidate; keep saves, earlier ZIPs and failed evidence. Compilation, selected native renders and package acceptance remain distinct.

phases.title: Pass the human and Steam release gates
criteria: Verify onboarding, app identity, store/pricing/content survey, playable build review, install/launch and discount eligibility in the authorized Steam workflow.
Every actual game release updates this tracker with the matching download and instructions, then verifies the live site. Public release, merge and promotion require their remaining approvals.
phases.gate: November 2 review candidate and November 16 release are planning targets, not promises. Fee-credit evidence is recorded privately; app identity and account gates remain unverified. The October 19/20 submission-date discrepancy needs reconciliation. No new game build is published by this roadmap update.

routine.label: Private profile/menu continuation / not packaged
routine.passed: The later profile2 source passed all four managed assemblies, a fresh three-biome bake and 145 focused native cases: 76 rules, 43 menu/appearance/footprint flows, 24 campaign-reset/results regressions and two GPU capture cases. Zero failures or forced cleanup on this final focused run.
routine.visual: 72 original-game PNGs were produced: 65 staged hands/equipment poses, two original-rig palette/mittens renders and five bloody-trail/control renders. Representative images were inspected. These are staged URP renders, not actual menu/HUD or human art acceptance.
routine.limits: Nickname/color Apply/Cancel, separate profile storage/reopen, validated color codec, original rigs and Santa-color restoration have focused native evidence. A fresh full Windows build/package, separate-process profile/color late join, density measurement, actual IMGUI capture and physical hardware acceptance remain open. The Core8 horde measurements above belong to Core8, not this changed source. Existing downloads are unchanged.
